historical_migration_snapshot.scope: Active workspace including .git/.env; full retained private archive directory and metadata; carried-forward known incremental shared-cache bytes. Pre-existing shared Android/JDK/Gradle installations excluded. Snapshot before initial documentation commit.

latest_phone_build.basis: Allocated du -sk KiB converted to bytes, conservative historic logical archive/cache reserve; pre-existing SDK/JDK excluded. Missing archive prevents certified complete inventory. Phone target files included additionally; historical phone model unchanged excluded as pre-existing. APK/device cache and untracked global caches not exhaustively inventoried.
latest_phone_build.model_scope: Separate Qwen core/projector and whisper weights excluded from Git/APK. Bundled ML Kit SDK assets remain in its dependency.

reference_conversion_peak.basis: Observed allocated workspace maximum plus target-phone files/cache, historical archive/cache reserves and known Gradle/UV cache growth. Source shard and converter venv retained at measurement; qualified accounting, not full machine inventory. Some components sampled at adjacent times.
